zh-CN: 灵猴身法
en-US: Monkey Agility

zh-CN: 不着重甲时保持灵猴般的迅捷，提升移动与跳跃能力。
en-US: Move and leap with simian agility while fighting light.

zh-CN: 如意兵法
en-US: Ruyi Mastery

zh-CN: 精通长棍与如意金箍棒；当敏捷高于力量时，符合武僧武器规则的攻击改用敏捷，否则保持力量。
en-US: Master the quarterstaff and Ruyi Jingu Bang; when Dexterity exceeds Strength, monk-eligible weapon attacks use Dexterity, otherwise they retain Strength.

zh-CN: 铜头铁臂
en-US: Copper Head, Iron Arms

zh-CN: 以仙躯硬撼刀兵，强化近战防御。
en-US: Harden your immortal body against physical blows.

zh-CN: 筋斗云
en-US: Somersault Cloud

zh-CN: 消耗1点仙力，以附赠动作驾云传送至选定落点。落地后获得1回合云势，使下一次近战攻击获得优势；传送距离随大圣等级提升。
en-US: Spend 1 Sage Qi and a Bonus Action to ride the cloud to a chosen point. After landing, gain Cloud Momentum for 1 turn, granting Advantage on your next melee attack; range increases with Great Sage level.

zh-CN: 火眼金睛
en-US: Fiery Golden Eyes

zh-CN: 看破妖邪与幻象，使目标显形并削弱其防御。
en-US: Pierce disguises and illusions, revealing and weakening the target.

zh-CN: 定海一棒
en-US: Sea-Calming Strike

zh-CN: 以金箍棒震击地面，对附近敌人造成雷鸣伤害，弱者更会被击倒并震退。
en-US: Smash the ground with the staff, dealing Thunder damage and knocking failed saves prone and away.

zh-CN: 云势
en-US: Cloud Momentum

zh-CN: 筋斗云带来的冲势使下一次近战攻击获得优势；首次近战攻击后云势消散。
en-US: Momentum from the Somersault Cloud grants Advantage on your next melee attack, then dissipates after that attack.

zh-CN: 妖邪显形
en-US: Demon Revealed

zh-CN: 目标的伪装被火眼金睛看破，护甲等级降低。
en-US: The target's disguise is pierced by Fiery Golden Eyes, reducing Armour Class.

zh-CN: 如意伸长
en-US: Ruyi Extension

zh-CN: 令金箍棒骤然伸长，打击远处的敌人。
en-US: Extend the Ruyi Jingu Bang to strike a distant foe.

zh-CN: 七十二变：小虫
en-US: Seventy-Two Transformations: Tiny Creature

zh-CN: 化作微小生灵，用于潜入狭窄区域与探索。首个技术原型暂借用猫形态验证变身链路。
en-US: Assume a tiny exploratory form for infiltration and traversal. The first technical prototype uses the Cat Wild Shape chain.

zh-CN: 七十二变：苍鹰
en-US: Seventy-Two Transformations: Eagle

zh-CN: 借飞禽之形腾空而起，跨越高低差与复杂地形。首个技术原型使用恐鸦形态验证飞行链路。
en-US: Take wing to cross vertical terrain and obstacles. The first technical prototype uses the Dire Raven Wild Shape chain.

zh-CN: 七十二变：猛虎
en-US: Seventy-Two Transformations: Tiger

zh-CN: 化作猛虎扑杀近敌，获得野兽形态的近战能力与耐久。首个技术原型使用剑齿虎形态。
en-US: Transform into a tiger-like combat form with beast melee attacks and durability. The first technical prototype uses the Sabre-Toothed Tiger Wild Shape chain.

zh-CN: 七十二变
en-US: Seventy-Two Transformations

zh-CN: 开启变化菜单，选择当前等级已经领悟的变化形态。
en-US: Open the transformation menu and choose a form learned at your current level.

zh-CN: 七十二变
en-US: Seventy-Two Transformations

zh-CN: 领悟变化之术，获得七十二变菜单并解锁小虫变化。
en-US: Learn the art of transformation, gaining the Seventy-Two Transformations menu and Tiny Creature form.

zh-CN: 七十二变·进境
en-US: Seventy-Two Transformations: Advancement

zh-CN: 变化之术更进一步，解锁苍鹰变化与猛虎变化。
en-US: Advance your transformation art, unlocking Eagle and Tiger forms.

zh-CN: 身外身法
en-US: Body Outside the Body

zh-CN: 拔下毫毛，唤出两具战斗分身，持续3回合。分身使用弱化棍法，并与本体的部分被动事件联动。
en-US: Pluck enchanted hairs to summon two combat clones for 3 rounds. They use weakened staff techniques and can interact with some caster passive events.

zh-CN: 毫毛化身
en-US: Hair Clone

zh-CN: 由大圣毫毛变化而成的短暂战斗分身。
en-US: A temporary combat clone formed from the Great Sage's enchanted hair.

zh-CN: 大圣闪避
en-US: Great Sage Evasion

zh-CN: 面对可通过敏捷豁免减半的伤害时，豁免成功则不受伤害，失败也只承受一半伤害。
en-US: When a Dexterity saving throw would halve damage, take no damage on a success and only half damage on a failure.

zh-CN: 金刚不坏
en-US: Diamond Body

zh-CN: 仙躯愈发坚不可摧：获得对非魔法钝击、穿刺与挥砍伤害的抗性，并在体质豁免中获得优势。
en-US: Your immortal body hardens: gain resistance to non-magical Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage, and Advantage on Constitution saving throws.

zh-CN: 三头六臂
en-US: Three Heads, Six Arms

zh-CN: 领悟三头六臂神通，可消耗仙力进入短暂的多臂战斗形态。
en-US: Learn the Three Heads, Six Arms divine art, allowing you to spend Sage Qi to enter a brief multi-armed combat form.

zh-CN: 三头六臂
en-US: Three Heads, Six Arms

zh-CN: 消耗4点仙力进入三头六臂形态，持续3回合：攻击动作可完成三次武器攻击，护甲等级+2，力量与敏捷豁免获得优势，并免疫恐惧状态组。
en-US: Spend 4 Sage Qi to enter Three Heads, Six Arms for 3 rounds: your Attack action can make three weapon attacks, you gain +2 Armour Class, Advantage on Strength and Dexterity saves, and immunity to the Frightened status group.

zh-CN: 三头六臂
en-US: Three Heads, Six Arms

zh-CN: 多臂神通强化近战攻防，但不会获得额外完整动作，也不会复制额外武器槽。
en-US: The multi-armed form strengthens melee offense and defense without granting a full extra action or duplicating weapon slots.

zh-CN: 法天象地
en-US: Law of Heaven and Earth

zh-CN: 领悟法天象地神通，可消耗仙力化作巨灵战躯。
en-US: Learn the Law of Heaven and Earth, allowing you to spend Sage Qi to assume a colossal divine combat form.

zh-CN: 法天象地
en-US: Law of Heaven and Earth

zh-CN: 消耗5点仙力进入法天象地，持续3回合且每长休只能使用一次。力量至少提升至25，体型巨化，并强化所有武器攻击。
en-US: Spend 5 Sage Qi to enter the Law of Heaven and Earth for 3 rounds, once per Long Rest. Your Strength becomes at least 25, your body grows, and your weapon attacks are empowered.

zh-CN: 法天象地
en-US: Law of Heaven and Earth

zh-CN: 巨化神躯使武器攻击额外造成2d8力场与2d8雷鸣伤害，并开放三种巨灵战技。
en-US: Your giant divine body adds 2d8 Force and 2d8 Thunder damage to weapon attacks and unlocks three colossal combat techniques.

zh-CN: 撼地
en-US: Earthshaker

zh-CN: 震裂前方大地，造成雷鸣伤害；未通过力量豁免的敌人倒地并被震退。
en-US: Shatter the ground ahead with thunder; enemies that fail a Strength save are knocked Prone and hurled back.

zh-CN: 横扫千军
en-US: Army-Sweeping Strike

zh-CN: 以巨化金箍棒横扫大片区域，造成主手武器伤害并击退敌人。
en-US: Sweep a vast area with your enlarged staff, dealing main-hand weapon damage and knocking enemies back.

zh-CN: 擎天一柱
en-US: Pillar Upholding Heaven

zh-CN: 将金箍棒伸向远处，以主手武器重击单个敌人并将其轰退。
en-US: Extend your staff to crush a distant foe with your main-hand weapon and blast it backward.

zh-CN: 齐天大圣
en-US: Great Sage, Equal to Heaven

zh-CN: 大圣神通圆满：仙力上限增加2点，移动距离增加3米，并免疫魅惑与恐惧。
en-US: Your Great Sage powers reach perfection: increase maximum Sage Qi by 2, gain 3m Movement, and become immune to Charmed and Frightened effects.
